post.summary:
Links the game to an IGDB game and fills its metadata. Posting the current
IGDB id refreshes it.

409.description: `igdb_linked`: another game has this IGDB id

422.description: `import_invalid`: preview the file to see why

copy_count.description: Copies assigned to this device, of any status.

platform_ids.description: Platforms this device plays, in platform list order.

ErrorBody.description:
Error body. `code` is a stable key the UI translates; it never carries
display text. `field` names the input field at fault, when there is one.

FileIssue.description: A problem with the file as a whole; no rows are read when there is one.

releases.description: In platform list order, then region.

last_played_copy_id.description: Must be a copy of this game.

platforms.description: Platforms with owned copies, in platform list order.

oneOf.description: Set when the file cannot be read at all; everything else is then empty.

game_count.description: Games with a release on this platform.

ids.description: Every platform id, once, in the new order.

Region.description: Release region, matching IGDB's release regions. `ww` also covers region-free.

error.description: Errors block the import; warnings do not.

copy_count.description: Copies bought at this store, of any status.

linked.description: Unlinked games matched by exact title.

unmatched.description: Unlinked games without exactly one match; link them by hand.
